cases.sql: CREATE TABLE items(id integer primary key)
CREATE FUNCTION stable_counter() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$BEGIN RAISE NOTICE 'stable_counter called'; RETURN 1; END$$
WITH c AS (SELECT id, stable_counter() AS marker FROM items) SELECT marker FROM c LIMIT 1
WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, stable_counter() AS marker FROM items) SELECT marker FROM c LIMIT 1
WITH c AS (SELECT id, stable_counter() AS marker FROM items) SELECT a.marker AS left_marker,b.marker AS right_marker FROM c a JOIN c b ON a.id=b.id ORDER BY a.id
WITH c AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, stable_counter() AS marker FROM items) SELECT a.marker AS left_marker,b.marker AS right_marker FROM c a JOIN c b ON a.id=b.id ORDER BY a.id
